propositions: A file bug-fixed twice or more within 7 days on the base branch should escalate to plan-review even when the current fix is under the 150-line threshold.
The repeat-fix predicate must evaluate non-test paths per-path (>=2 prior bug-fix commits in the window), not aggregate across paths, and must exclude merge commits and non-bug tickets.
The new escalation verdict must be a separate field from the existing `flagged` field (which pins to the size floor alone) to preserve the invariant checked by `--check-planning-corpus`.

An under-floor diff with repeat-fix hits must still resolve the commit's ticket and classify plan-review attestation; the pinned test `test_under_threshold_diff_never_reads_the_store` must be rewritten to reflect this narrower invariant.

Backtest script `--repeat-fix` and `--labels-from-caused-by` options must ship the predicate from the new module to avoid drift, and report recall per escalation signal (floor, repeat-fix, union) against the store's `caused_by` label set.
